title: Transition from the South Udasi to the East Udasi

blocks.text: This transition closes the southern travel materials and turns decisively toward the next itinerary. After the southern sequence concludes, the eastern udasi begins and the Guru's route opens through major places of pilgrimage and renunciant practice.

The page uses that travel shift to sharpen a moral contrast as well, because the Guru encounters outward holiness mixed with confusion, hypocrisy, and spiritual pretension. The journey east is therefore not scenic movement alone but a new field for testing and teaching.
Together with the adjacent readable pages, the passage works as a clean hinge between two udasis. It closes one circle of travel and launches the next phase of Guru Nanak's corrective wanderings.
